items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: Well I didn't know anything about that.

ctx.x: And he used to give parties and Dade Marmarisa would and play at the party.

Uh-huh. Well I didn't know anything about that. Well in fact my youngest daughter's mother and her cousin, they always came to school with me. They wanted to play piano. So they would just kill time out on the lawn talking until piano time class was and that was after my harmony and theory class.
